title: Savings & Copay Assistance Programs: Suspension, Resume Window and Rewards Points Settings
content:
Three settings of each program type of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs govern what happens when the patient's primary coverage becomes a government plan, how long a suspended program may be reinstated, and whether fills paid with the program's help may earn rewards points.

| Program type | Suspended when primary coverage becomes a government plan | Resume window after suspension (calendar days) | Fills paid with the program's help may earn rewards points |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Rx Discount Card | No | 0 | Yes |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | No | 0 | Yes |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | No | 0 | Yes |
| Manufacturer Copay Card | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Manufacturer Bridge Program | Yes | 0 | No |
| Charitable Foundation Copay Grant | No | 30 | No |

## Settings explained

- **Suspended on government coverage** — Yes for the Manufacturer Copay Card and the Manufacturer Bridge Program: the program is suspended when the patient's primary coverage becomes a government plan.
- **Resume window** — the calendar days after suspension within which the program may be reinstated: 60 days on the Manufacturer Copay Card, 30 days on the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant, and 0 on the others.
- **Rewards points on program fills** — Yes on the three Kestrel discount programs and the Manufacturer Copay Card; No on the Manufacturer Bridge Program and the Charitable Foundation Copay Grant, whose program-paid fills do not earn points.

## Hypothetical reading

A hypothetical Manufacturer Copay Card suspended on a given day may be reinstated within a 60-day window; a hypothetical Charitable Foundation Copay Grant suspended the same day has a 30-day window.
